name: Deniable pad store (v1, then v2) and zk identity store on the real Nitrokey (tools/padstore.py, tools/zkid.py)
hardware: Nitrokey 3, test vault (one non-resident FIDO2 credential); three PIN + touch unlocks

indistinguishability_replicates.method: 20 stores of each shape rebuilt with the same operations (software keys; the ciphertext layout is what is tested): 24 MiB, a one-day book in the decoy, and in the two-layer store another in the hidden layer; byte chi-square of the whole file
indistinguishability_replicates.reading: both shapes follow the chi-square law of random bytes and cannot be told apart; the hardware run's 296.6 (p = 0.038, one draw) is within that spread

limits: one seizure only: two images show which blocks changed
flash wear-levelling and journaling keep old blocks
the decoy must be used believably
a lower layer opened alone can overwrite higher ones once its free space meets theirs

result_v1.chi2_note: 255 degrees of freedom: about 255 +- 22.6 for random bytes

result_v2.chi2_note: 255 degrees of freedom: about 255 +- 22.6 for random bytes

store_versions: v1: one header slot per layer, rewritten in place (05:36 run). v2, after the 16 Nov audit: two header generations per layer, copy-on-write data, one store lock (08:10 run). The replicate statistics below were made on v1; v2's two runs (chi2 215.3 two-layer, 244.7 one-layer) are within the same spread.
